- Complete a safe, owner-gated live audit and real end-to-end IVX autonomous-worker deployment with verifiable production evidence.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Complete controls sequentially: inspect, fix, test, publish, deploy, live-verify, attach evidence, then mark PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL.
- Preserve Supabase JWT owner authorization; do not use legacy static owner tokens.
- Preserve HMAC, expiring, single-use, exact action/SHA-bound worker authorization.
- Never expose, print, commit, request, or manufacture secret values.
- Do not impersonate the dedicated worker, forge approvals, weaken authorization, bypass approvals, or manufacture production evidence.
- Public chat policy blocks must be HTTP `200` renderable turns; authorization failures remain `401`/`403`; `409` is reserved for state conflicts.
- Do not claim deployment, signed-worker execution, production mutation, compliance, tax filing, or mobile-store readiness without fresh evidence.
- Do not submit to Google Play, App Store, or TestFlight.
- Exclude unrelated `.rork/history/main/*.json` and `ios-ivx-holdings/` changes from publication.
- Do not represent QA fixtures/accounting reporting as real transfers, tax filing, regulatory compliance, CPA review, or tax-authority acceptance.

## Progress
### Done
- Published website correction release to authorized GitHub repository `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest`:
  - commit: `c7ca154b39f2db7e0a7597d146783d87098c9c8d`
  - message: `fix: repair production landing API contract`
  - files: `expo/deploy-landing.mjs`, `expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html`.
- Deployed landing through S3/CloudFront distribution `E1C0DEI0VKCUYN` / `d1f3efsob2d4cv.cloudfront.net`; artifact checks confirmed CSP, GET waitlist, and `/health` corrections.
- Landing verification passed:
  - `/`, `/capture`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, legal pages, APK, static deal feeds, and `/health` returned HTTP `200`.

  - FCP `3.0 s`; LCP `11.2 s`; TBT `70 ms`; CLS `0.003`.

  - `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health` returned `{"ok":true,"status":"healthy","commit":"c7ca154b39f2db7e0a7597d146783d87098c9c8d"}`.
  - `GET /version` previously returned HTTP `200` on the same SHA.
  - `POST /api/public/chat` with `{"message":"deploy now"}` returned HTTP `200` with visible `STATE: BLOCKED`.
  - unauthenticated deployment-approval, worker-job, and worker-status calls returned HTTP `401`, `secretValuesReturned:false`.
  - owner-authenticated `GET /api/ivx/audit-jobs` returned HTTP `200` with zero jobs.
- Fresh owner worker-status check passed:
  - `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/status` returned HTTP `200`, `secretValuesReturned:false`.
  - confirms durable queue, per-owner single-flight, stale expiration, cancellation, resumption, attach-to-running, stages, proof ledger, owner approval gate, and secret-safe logging.
- Fresh non-mutating QA-only job completed:
  - job: `ivx-worker-f2675b9e-b6d2-41d4-a973-c5b37a218786`

  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts` verifies requested base SHA against current GitHub HEAD before consuming `GITHUB_WRITE`.

  - result: `16 pass`, `0 fail`.

### In Progress
- Validate autonomous task API compilation and lifecycle behavior after exact-SHA and post-commit Render-approval changes.

- Determine whether worker-only internal authorization variables and GitHub/Render mutation capability are securely provisioned on Render without reading secret values.
- Prepare a minimal, safe, owner-authorized real-worker end-to-end drill after publication and API/worker SHA parity verification.
- Exercise non-mutating live pause/cancel/resume and, if safely supported, stale-task recovery.
- Classify the `189` freeze-risk findings and run focused treasury/accounting regressions and owner-authorized reporting probes.

### Blocked
- Autonomous lifecycle repair and Render configuration update remain local/unpublished; no live worker source has changed.
- No actual autonomous GitHub write, Render deployment, or signed-worker approval consumption has been executed in production.
- Production end-to-end verification requires dedicated `ivx-senior-dev-01` configuration, without exposing values:
  - `IVX_INTERNAL_DEPLOY_SECRET`
  - `IVX_INTERNAL_WORKER_ID`
  - `IVX_INTERNAL_API_URL=https://api.ivxholding.com`
  - authorized `GITHUB_REPO_URL`, GitHub write credential, `RENDER_API_KEY`, and `RENDER_SERVICE_ID`.
- Prior audited runtime capability status showed:
  - `GITHUB_REPO_URL:false`
  - `GITHUB_TOKEN:true`
  - `RENDER_API_KEY:false`
  - `RENDER_SERVICE_ID:true`
  - `seniorDeveloperRuntime.variablesValidated:false`
  - `seniorDeveloperRuntime.toolRegistryReady:false`
  - `github.canReadRepo:false`
  - `github.canPush:false`
  - `render.canDeploy:false`.
- Full typecheck remains blocked by pre-existing unrelated errors, including:
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(82,39): error TS2339: Property 'totalDistributions' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(84,21): error TS2339: Property 'lastActivityDate' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(114,23): error TS2339: Property 'id' does not exist on type 'LedgerEntry'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts(7712,9): error TS2322: Type '"ivx_qa_only_runtime"' is not assignable...`
  - existing `backend/hono.ts` owner-auth call-site errors around lines `5063` onward: `Expected 2 arguments`, missing `.ok`, `.response`, and `.userId`.
  - direct `bunx tsc --noEmit --pretty false` also reports test-global errors in `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.test.ts`, including missing `beforeEach`, `afterEach`, `describe`, `test`, and `expect`.
- Freeze-risk control remains PARTIAL: `189` freeze risks and `203` high-severity findings remain unclassified.
- Landing performance remains below a strict 100% target: Lighthouse performance `0.69`, LCP `11.2 s`, primarily remote deal imagery.
- Android signing/device proof, iOS production-build proof, monitoring alerts, retry/dead-letter proof, rollback drill, database integrity audit, security review, and final end-to-end QA remain absent.

## Key Decisions
- Do not deploy or claim 100% end-to-end autonomous-worker readiness until source publication, worker configuration, signed execution, and live verification are evidenced.
- Keep HMAC deployment authorization intact; do not use local substitutes, forged headers, reduced requirements, approval bypasses, or worker impersonation.
- Require autonomous submissions to supply an exact current `requestedCommitSha` and `GITHUB_WRITE` approval before protected work begins.
- Bind `GITHUB_WRITE` to approved current repository HEAD and re-check HEAD before the worker writes.
- Create and persist `RENDER_DEPLOY` internal approval only after the actual commit SHA exists; bind it to that exact committed SHA.
- Require autonomous tasks to reload task metadata after owner deploy approval so the worker uses the newly persisted internal approval.
- Preserve existing owner-only `/worker/jobs` behavior; apply internal HMAC submission requirements only to `/autonomous-worker/` aliases.
- Treat `ivx-worker-f2675b9e-b6d2-41d4-a973-c5b37a218786` as QA lifecycle evidence only, not signed-worker proof.
- Publish only reviewed authorized source changes to `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest`; exclude `.rork/history/main/*.json` and unrelated iOS files.
- Present 1099/tax output only as accounting support/tax-preparation data, never filing/compliance evidence.

9. If a commit is produced, create owner `RENDER_DEPLOY` approval bound to that committed SHA; verify deployment ID, live health, and GitHub/API/Render SHA parity.
